scenario.title: Library Management System
scenario.description:
A registered library member logs into the library system, searches for a book, checks its availability, borrows the book, and verifies the borrowing details.

Features to test
Feature	What to verify
Login	Valid/invalid login, mandatory fields
Book Search	Search by title, author, ISBN, no-result search
Book Details	Title, author, availability, number of copies
Borrow Book	Borrow available book, borrowing limit
Borrow Confirmation	Due date, borrowed book details, confirmation
Return Book	Return borrowed book, status update

reference_cases.title: Successful login with valid credentials
reference_cases.preconditions: User has a registered account with username 'testuser' and password 'Test@123'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Enter username 'testuser'
3. Enter password 'Test@123'
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: User is logged in successfully and redirected to the home/dashboard page. Username is displayed in the header.

reference_cases.title: Login fails with incorrect password
reference_cases.preconditions: User has a registered account with username 'testuser'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Enter valid username 'testuser'
3. Enter incorrect password 'wrongpass'
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Login fails with error message 'Invalid username or password' displayed. User remains on login page.

reference_cases.title: Login with empty username field
reference_cases.preconditions: None
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Leave username field empty
3. Enter password 'Test@123'
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message appears indicating username is required. Login does not proceed.

reference_cases.title: Login with empty password field
reference_cases.preconditions: None
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Enter username 'testuser'
3. Leave password field empty
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message appears indicating password is required. Login does not proceed.

reference_cases.title: Search for book by exact title match
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' exists in the library catalog
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'The Great Gatsby' in the search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Search results display 'The Great Gatsby' with correct author, ISBN, and availability status

reference_cases.title: Search for book by partial title
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' exists in the library catalog
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'Great Gatsby' (without 'The') in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Search results include 'The Great Gatsby' and any other books with matching keywords

reference_cases.title: Search for book by author name
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Books by 'F. Scott Fitzgerald' exist in catalog
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'F. Scott Fitzgerald' in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: All books by F. Scott Fitzgerald are displayed in search results

reference_cases.title: Search for book by ISBN
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book with ISBN '978-0-7432-7356-5' exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter ISBN '978-0-7432-7356-5'
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Exact book matching the ISBN is displayed with all details

reference_cases.title: Search with non-existent book title
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'XYZ123NonExistentBook999' in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: No results found message is displayed. No books are shown in results.

reference_cases.title: Search with empty search field
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Leave search box empty
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Either validation error appears asking to enter search term, or all books are displayed

reference_cases.title: Search with special characters only
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter '@#$%^&*' in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: No results found or appropriate error message. System doesn't crash.

reference_cases.title: View book details for available book
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' has 3 copies available
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book from search results
reference_cases.expected_result: Book details page shows title, author, ISBN, availability status as 'Available', and number of copies (3 available out of total)

reference_cases.title: View book details for unavailable book
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'To Kill a Mockingbird' has 0 copies available (all borrowed)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'To Kill a Mockingbird'
2. Click on the book from search results
reference_cases.expected_result: Book details page shows title, author, ISBN, availability status as 'Not Available' or 'All copies borrowed', 0 copies available

reference_cases.title: Borrow an available book successfully
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' is available. User has not exceeded borrowing limit
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
4. Confirm borrowing action if prompted
reference_cases.expected_result: Book is borrowed successfully. Confirmation message is displayed. Available copies count decreases by 1.

reference_cases.title: Attempt to borrow book with zero availability
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'To Kill a Mockingbird' has 0 available copies
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'To Kill a Mockingbird'
2. Click on the book
3. Attempt to click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Borrow button is either disabled/not visible, or clicking it shows error message 'No copies available'

reference_cases.title: Attempt to borrow when at borrowing limit
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has already borrowed maximum allowed books (e.g., 5 books)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for an available book
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'You have reached your borrowing limit' or similar. Book is not borrowed.

reference_cases.title: Verify borrowing limit boundary - borrow last allowed book
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has borrowed 4 books (limit is 5)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for an available book
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Book is borrowed successfully. User now has 5 borrowed books (at the limit).

reference_cases.title: View borrowing confirmation details
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for available book 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
4. View confirmation page/message
reference_cases.expected_result: Confirmation displays: book title, author, borrow date (today's date), due date (typically 14-30 days from today), and success message

reference_cases.title: Verify due date calculation is correct
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Borrowing period is 14 days
reference_cases.steps:
1. Note today's date
2. Search for available book
3. Borrow the book
4. Check due date on confirmation
reference_cases.expected_result: Due date is exactly 14 days from today's date (accounting for weekends/holidays per library policy)

reference_cases.title: Verify borrowed book appears in user's borrowed list
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to 'My Books' or 'Borrowed Books' section
2. Note current borrowed books
3. Borrow a new book 'The Great Gatsby'
4. Return to 'My Books' section
reference_cases.expected_result: 'The Great Gatsby' now appears in the borrowed books list with borrow date and due date

reference_cases.title: Return a borrowed book successfully
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has borrowed book 'The Great Gatsby'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to 'My Books' or 'Borrowed Books' section
2. Locate 'The Great Gatsby' in borrowed list
3. Click 'Return' button
4. Confirm return if prompted
reference_cases.expected_result: Book is returned successfully. Confirmation message appears. Book is removed from borrowed list or status changes to 'Returned'.

reference_cases.title: Verify book availability increases after return
reference_cases.preconditions: User has borrowed 'The Great Gatsby'. Before borrowing, it had 3 available copies, now has 2
reference_cases.steps:
1. Return 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
3. View book details
reference_cases.expected_result: Available copies count is now 3 (increased by 1 after return)

reference_cases.title: Verify returned book can be borrowed again
reference_cases.preconditions: User has just returned 'The Great Gatsby'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Book can be borrowed again successfully without issues

reference_cases.title: Attempt to borrow the same book twice
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has already borrowed 'The Great Gatsby'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message: 'You have already borrowed this book' or borrow button is disabled

reference_cases.title: Search with very long string input
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to search page
2. Enter a very long string (500+ characters) in search box
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: System handles gracefully - either truncates input, shows validation error, or returns no results. No crash or performance issue.

reference_cases.title: Login with SQL injection attempt
reference_cases.preconditions: None
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter username as: admin' OR '1'='1
3. Enter any password
4. Click Login
reference_cases.expected_result: Login fails with invalid credentials error. No SQL injection occurs. User is not logged in.

reference_cases.title: Verify session timeout after inactivity
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Session timeout is set (e.g., 30 minutes)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Log in successfully
2. Remain idle for the timeout period
3. Attempt to perform any action (search, borrow)
reference_cases.expected_result: User is logged out automatically. Redirected to login page with session expired message.

reference_cases.title: Case insensitive book search
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to search page
2. Enter 'the great gatsby' (all lowercase)
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: 'The Great Gatsby' appears in search results. Search is case-insensitive.

unsupported.title: Verify session timeout after inactivity
unsupported.reason: Session timeout requires time-based session management which is not modeled in this in-memory practice app

plan.summary: A library system where members log in, search for books, check availability, borrow and return books with borrowing limits.

test_accounts.notes: Standard test account with no books borrowed initially
Account that starts with 5 books already borrowed (at limit)

helpers.name: setup
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Resets the app to initial state: logs out any user, clears visible message, resets to Login page, restores all data to starting state (users, books, borrowings as defined in data section)

helpers.name: teardown
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If id is provided and matches a borrowing record created during test, removes that borrowing and restores book availability. If id is None, does nothing (setup handles full reset)

helpers.name: current_page
helpers.returns: String: name of current page ('Login', 'Home', 'Search', 'Book Details', or 'My Books')
helpers.behaviour: Returns the name of the page currently displayed

helpers.name: visible_message
helpers.returns: String: the current message shown to user, or empty string if no message
helpers.behaviour: Returns the current visible message text exactly as shown on screen

helpers.name: logged_in_user
helpers.returns: String: username of logged in user, or empty string if not logged in
helpers.behaviour: Returns the username displayed in header if logged in, empty string otherwise

helpers.name: navigate_to_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Navigates to the Login page, clears any visible message

helpers.name: navigate_to_search
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If logged in, navigates to Search page and clears message. If not logged in, sets message 'Please log in first' and stays on current page

helpers.name: navigate_to_my_books
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If logged in, navigates to My Books page and clears message. If not logged in, sets message 'Please log in first' and stays on current page

helpers.name: enter_username
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Enters the given username into the username field on Login page. Does nothing if not on Login page

helpers.name: enter_password
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Enters the given password into the password field on Login page. Does nothing if not on Login page

helpers.name: click_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Attempts login with current username and password fields. If username empty, sets message 'Username is required' and stays on Login. If password empty, sets message 'Password is required' and stays on Login. If credentials invalid, sets message 'Invalid username or password' and stays on Login. If valid, logs in user, navigates to Home page, clears message

helpers.name: click_logout
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Logs out current user, navigates to Login page, sets message 'You have been logged out'

helpers.name: enter_search_term
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Enters the given search term into the search box on Search page. Does nothing if not on Search page

helpers.name: click_search
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Performs search with current search term. Searches across title, author, and ISBN (case-insensitive, partial match). If search term is empty, displays all books. Sets message 'No results found' if no matches. Stays on Search page and displays results

helpers.name: search_results
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{book_id, title, author, isbn, availability_status, available_copies, total_copies}, ...] for books matching last search, or empty list if no results
helpers.behaviour: Returns the list of books currently displayed in search results. availability_status is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, else 'Not Available'

helpers.name: click_book
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Navigates to Book Details page for the specified book_id. If book_id doesn't exist, sets message 'Book not found' and stays on current page. Clears message if successful

helpers.name: book_details
helpers.returns: Object: {book_id, title, author, isbn, availability_status, available_copies, total_copies} for currently displayed book, or None if not on Book Details page
helpers.behaviour: Returns details of the book currently shown on Book Details page. availability_status is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, else 'Not Available'

helpers.name: borrow_button_visible
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if Borrow button is visible and enabled, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Returns true if on Book Details page, user is logged in, book has available copies > 0, user hasn't borrowed this book already, and user is under borrowing limit. Otherwise false

helpers.name: click_borrow
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to borrow the currently displayed book. If not logged in, sets message 'Please log in first'. If no copies available, sets message 'No copies available'. If user already borrowed this book, sets message 'You have already borrowed this book'. If at borrowing limit (5 books), sets message 'You have reached your borrowing limit'. If successful, creates borrowing record with borrow_date 2024-01-20 and due_date 2024-02-03 (14 days later), decrements available_copies, sets message 'Book borrowed successfully. Due date: 2024-02-03', stays on Book Details page

helpers.name: borrowed_books_list
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{book_id, title, author, borrow_date, due_date}, ...] for books borrowed by current user, or empty list if none or not logged in
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of books currently borrowed by the logged-in user, shown on My Books page. Empty list if not on My Books page or not logged in

helpers.name: click_return
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to return the specified book. If user hasn't borrowed this book, sets message 'You have not borrowed this book' and does nothing. If successful, removes borrowing record, increments book's available_copies, sets message 'Book returned successfully', stays on My Books page

helpers.name: login
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, user: username} if successful, or {ok: false, error: message} if failed
helpers.behaviour: Validates credentials. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Username is required'} if username empty. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Password is required'} if password empty. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Invalid username or password'} if credentials don't match any user. Returns {ok: true, user: username} if valid, and logs in the user

helpers.name: logout
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true}
helpers.behaviour: Logs out current user and returns {ok: true}

helpers.name: search_books
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, books: [{book_id, title, author, isbn, availability_status, available_copies, total_copies}, ...]}
helpers.behaviour: Searches for books matching term (case-insensitive, partial match) in title, author, or ISBN. If term is empty, returns all books. Returns {ok: true, books: []} if no matches. availability_status is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, else 'Not Available'

helpers.name: get_book_details
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, book: {book_id, title, author, isbn, availability_status, available_copies, total_copies}} if found, or {ok: false, error: 'Book not found'} if not found
helpers.behaviour: Returns details for specified book_id. availability_status is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, else 'Not Available'

helpers.name: borrow_book
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, borrow_date: '2024-01-20', due_date: '2024-02-03'} if successful, or {ok: false, error: message} if failed
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to borrow book for user. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Book not found'} if book_id invalid. Returns {ok: false, error: 'No copies available'} if available_copies is 0. Returns {ok: false, error: 'You have already borrowed this book'} if user already has active borrowing of this book. Returns {ok: false, error: 'You have reached your borrowing limit'} if user has 5 borrowed books. If successful, creates borrowing with borrow_date 2024-01-20 and due_date 2024-02-03, decrements available_copies, returns {ok: true, borrow_date: '2024-01-20', due_date: '2024-02-03'}

helpers.name: return_book
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true} if successful, or {ok: false, error: 'You have not borrowed this book'} if failed
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to return book for user. Returns {ok: false, error: 'You have not borrowed this book'} if user doesn't have active borrowing of this book. If successful, removes borrowing record, increments book's available_copies, returns {ok: true}

helpers.name: get_borrowed_books
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, books: [{book_id, title, author, borrow_date, due_date}, ...]}
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of books currently borrowed by the specified user. Returns empty list if user has no borrowed books

helpers.name: get_user
helpers.returns: Object: {username, password, name, borrowed_count} if user exists, or None if not found
helpers.behaviour: Returns user record from database for specified username, or None if user doesn't exist

helpers.name: get_book
helpers.returns: Object: {book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies} if book exists, or None if not found
helpers.behaviour: Returns book record from database for specified book_id, or None if book doesn't exist

helpers.name: get_all_books
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all book records from database

helpers.name: get_borrowing
helpers.returns: Object: {username, book_id, borrow_date, due_date} if active borrowing exists, or None if not found
helpers.behaviour: Returns borrowing record for specified user and book if it exists and is active, or None otherwise

helpers.name: get_all_borrowings
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{username, book_id, borrow_date, due_date}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all active borrowing records for specified username. Returns empty list if user has no borrowings

helpers.name: count_user_borrowings
helpers.returns: Integer: number of books currently borrowed by user
helpers.behaviour: Returns count of active borrowing records for specified username

rules: Users must log in with valid username and password to access the system
Username and password fields are mandatory for login
Search is case-insensitive and matches partial text in title, author, or ISBN fields
Empty search term displays all books
Book availability status is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, otherwise 'Not Available'
Users can borrow a book only if: available_copies > 0, user hasn't already borrowed it, and user has fewer than 5 borrowed books
Borrowing limit is 5 books per user
Loan period is 14 days from borrow date
Borrow date is always 2024-01-20 (fixed current date)
Due date is always 2024-02-03 (14 days after borrow date)
Borrowing a book decrements available_copies by 1
Returning a book increments available_copies by 1
Users cannot borrow the same book twice simultaneously
Users can only return books they have currently borrowed
Invalid login attempts do not grant access and show error message
SQL injection attempts are treated as invalid credentials

not_supported: Session timeout - test case 27 requires time-based session management which is not modeled in this in-memory practice app
Real date/time calculations - the app uses fixed dates (current: 2024-01-20, due: 2024-02-03) instead of dynamic date calculations
Multiple simultaneous user sessions - the app maintains single session state
Actual SQL database - uses in-memory data structures instead
Network operations - all operations are local
